initial_views_status: predeclared fixtures, matched by offline reads, not live model inputs
dynamic_R5_views: assembled from actual post-proposal authoritative reads; hashes are recorded then, not invented now
request_serialization: UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False, sorted object keys, compact separators, no non-JSON numbers
raw_model_output_serialization: retain the exact extracted text bytes and complete original HTTP response bytes; never reserialize before the paired store replay
API_request_fields: exact frozen model/settings plus instructions and one JSON-encoded input string
output_formats: fixed Stage 3 proposal schema for P001-P003 and decision schema for A001-A004
token_bound_policy: Live transport requires a separate verified host bound record naming the exact request SHA-256, model, bound <=8192 and the method record hash. No such record is supplied here.
account_access_status: not_verified; this binding does not add an account-access proof as an acceptance criterion
